name: Destructive actions (positive)
note: ec2:TerminateInstances + rds:DeleteDBInstance are delete/terminate-family actions, so DESTRUCTIVE-ACTION fires and no wildcard ACTION is present. One of the two resources - arn:aws:ec2:us-east-1:111122223333:instance/* - is a resource-TYPE-prefixed wildcard (concrete type head 'instance' + leading-wildcard identifier) that reaches EVERY instance in the account/region, so the grant is broadly resource-scoped and WILDCARD-RESOURCE (high) MUST fire at the raw rule layer (exactFindingIds), where IAM-201 correlation then folds it into the same-statement DESTRUCTIVE-ACTION capability, so the correlated analyze() view (findingIds) shows DESTRUCTIVE-ACTION with WILDCARD-RESOURCE subsumed. Only the rds resource (db:app-*) is a concrete name-prefix; the instance one is account-wide. (Corrected in S1-dataexfil-arn iteration 3: type-prefixed leading-wildcard identifiers such as instance/*, role/*, accesspoint/*/object/* are account-wide, not scoped - previously this fixture wrongly asserted no WILDCARD-RESOURCE, a fail-open.)
